source.title: Call for Applicants - WCT Members (March 2019)
source.content:
The WCA Communication Team (WCT) is seeking members to help with managing and creating WCA social media posts or graphic design for social media posts and other projects!

The application is open to all WCA members. You do not have to hold a current position to be considered. 

**What does the WCT do?**
- Answers daily inquires to the WCA through emails, the contact page on the WCA website, and social media direct messages
- Manages official WCA social media platforms through frequent & engaging posts
- Works with other WCA leaders to improve the WCA website and communications to the community
- The rights and duties of WCT from our By-laws can be found [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1WoMypP_o06DXhJ8jvZ2pcsWgN_bG0zyjSnsBlyY8ls8/edit?usp=sharing)
<!-- break -->
**Workflow Outline**
- Social media posts are planned at least 1 week in advance and are posted when members are available. 
- Internal emails regarding other WCT projects are answered within 48 hours and other work may come from those projects that take various amounts of time.
- Time commitment per week is between 4-10 hours.
- FOR GRAPHICS APPLICANTS: Must be familiar with Adobe Illustrator, GIMP, or equivalent programs

**Characteristics we are looking for**
- Creativity: *We always need ideas of new social media series or unique ways to expand to other platforms. You will be required to think about this and suggest ideas when you can. For those with graphic design experience, you will be required to help us with designing visually compelling posts.*
- Social media knowledge: *You should be familiar with many social media platforms and their basic functions. While you may not have used them personally, you will have to post to them as the WCA and should know what type of content goes on each.*
- Fluent English: *Our posts on most social media platforms are in English and we answer most emails in English. We do welcome those that are fluent in other languages alongside English.*
- Communication skills: *You will be responsible for writing social media posts that are appropriate and convey the mission of the WCA. You should be able to write a professional, concise email to answer competitor questions and to convey a thorough knowledge of the WCA resources for competitors.* 
- Patience: *You should keep friendly communications within our email and social media interactions. Always maintaining professionalism when answering the same question many times is hard, but necessary for our day-to-day communications.* 

**To apply, please include:**
- A brief personal introduction
- Your involvement with the WCA
- Your motivation for applying to the WCT
- Your familiarity with social media platforms & an idea of a potential WCA post
- FOR GRAPHIC APPLICANTS: 2-3 designs that you have created to highlight your design style

**Please send the application in PDF format to [lclement@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:lclement@worldcubeassociation.org) from now until April 2, 2019, 23:59 UTC to be considered.**

A reply will be sent to confirm that the documents are in good order or to report on deficiencies otherwise once received. There may be an additional interview requested of candidates with the leader following application submission. The two weeks after the application period, the team will make a selection and the new member(s) will be announced once candidates have accepted the positions.

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: WCA 通讯组成员招募（2019 年 3 月）
translation.content:
WCA 通讯组（WCT）正在招募成员，协助管理和创作 WCA 社交媒体内容，或为社交媒体帖文及其他项目进行平面设计！

所有 WCA 成员均可申请，不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。

**WCT 的工作是什么？**

- 回复通过电子邮件、WCA 网站联系页面及社交媒体私信收到的日常咨询。
- 管理 WCA 官方社交媒体，定期发布有吸引力的内容。
- 与 WCA 其他负责人合作，改进 WCA 网站及与社区的沟通。
- 章程所列的 WCT 权利与职责可在[此处](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1WoMypP_o06DXhJ8jvZ2pcsWgN_bG0zyjSnsBlyY8ls8/edit?usp=sharing)查看。

**工作安排概况**

- 社交媒体帖文至少提前一周规划，并在成员有空时发布。
- 与 WCT 其他项目有关的内部邮件须在 48 小时内回复；这些项目还可能带来耗时不同的其他工作。
- 每周需投入 4 至 10 小时。
- 平面设计申请者须熟悉 Adobe Illustrator、GIMP 或同类软件。

**我们希望你具备的能力**

- 创意：*我们一直需要新的社交媒体系列创意，或拓展到其他平台的独特方法。你需要主动思考，并在有想法时提出建议。有平面设计经验的成员还须帮助我们设计有视觉吸引力的帖文。*
- 社交媒体知识：*你应熟悉多种社交媒体平台及其基本功能。即使你个人没有用过，也需要代表 WCA 在这些平台发帖，并了解各平台适合什么类型的内容。*
- 流利的英语：*我们在大多数社交媒体平台上使用英语，也用英语回复大部分邮件。同时欢迎既熟练掌握英语、又精通其他语言的申请者。*
- 沟通能力：*你将负责撰写得体、能传达 WCA 使命的社交媒体帖文。你应能用专业、简洁的邮件回答选手的问题，并熟悉 WCA 为选手提供的各类资源。*
- 耐心：*在邮件及社交媒体互动中，你应保持友善。反复回答同样的问题时仍保持专业并不容易，但这是日常沟通的必要要求。*

**申请材料请包括：**

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 参与 WCA 的经历。
- 申请加入 WCT 的原因。
- 对社交媒体平台的熟悉程度，以及一个可供 WCA 发布的帖文创意。
- 平面设计申请者：提供 2 至 3 件你创作的设计，展示个人风格。

**申请自即日起开放，请于 2019 年 4 月 2 日 23:59 UTC 前，将 PDF 格式的材料发送至 [lclement@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:lclement@worldcubeassociation.org)。**

收到后，我们会回复确认材料齐全，或说明需要补充的内容。提交申请后，候选人可能还须参加团队负责人的面试。申请截止后的两周内，团队将选定人选，待候选人接受职务后公布新成员。

提前感谢大家的申请与支持！
